outcome: length of stay in intensive care unit
cohort: Women aged 20 to 40 years (mean age 25 +/- 2.83 years) who underwent emergency peripartum hysterectomies at a tertiary care medical teaching hospital in Telangana, India, between May 2017 and May 2022.
finding: The incidence of emergency peripartum hysterectomy was 0.09% (39 out of 42703 deliveries), with placental causes and atonic PPH being the most common indications, and previous caesarean section being a significant risk factor.
